title: Analysis of the efficiency of china’s distance economic education in force majeure circumstances
reason: Descriptive anonymous survey of 498 economics students about distance-learning platforms, content and effectiveness during COVID-19, reported as response percentages. No platform-recorded indicator; all data self-report.

extraction.n_quote: an anonymous survey was conducted with participation of 498 students of the 1st-4th year of study majoring in Business Economics from the Economics Department.
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-reported platform preferences and perceived effectiveness of distance learning
extraction.notes: Activity-product analysis is mentioned among methods but no such data are reported.
